args.text:
Batch: 8 runs, all 8 accepted. 1 flagged, 7 cleared.
Flagged: r03, summary_outlier. Its largest flank difference is -11.7 %/h against a batch median of -8.1 (z -18.7). That 3.6 %/h gap is real and means the curvature-rate profile has a different shape. r03 is the only run that kept a remedy (frames registered on tissue from 400 px from the tip). Its REGR peak (52.77 vs 53.04 %/h) and growth-zone length (705 vs 695 µm) are close to the batch. Their large z values come from the very small batch MAD.
Cleared: r01, r02, r04, r05, r06, r07, r08. All checks pass with margin, no remedies or roll backs were kept, and the velocity and strain-rate profiles match the batch. The largest differences are small: flank-difference position 432 vs 410 µm, and growth-zone length 674 vs 695 µm.
Common to the flagged run: only one run is flagged, so there is no pattern. Its odd flank difference goes with the one kept registration remedy.
Note: several runs have identical checks and summaries: r01 = r04 = r07, r02 = r05, and r06 = r08. This holds even where the step counts differ (r07 took 5 steps against 1, r06 took 6 against 1). Check that these are different roots or windows and not repeated entries.
